review_brief:
# Review: 1409f5f7af2e

Repaired a base-support hole: ordinary generation omitted shared-endpoint chains, so an isolation-only shortcut fit all generated scenes.
Built a two-setting native family preserving the exact canonical default and adding a real fill → per-column red-count intermediate → winner-column highlight dependency.
The first family leaked winner location through dimensions; fixed winner placement to vary by seed at fixed shape and retained a regression.
Minimum lessons then admitted rank/scan-order, endpoint-only, nonlocal-vertical, diagonal, and raw-green-frequency shortcuts; crossed controls and targeted decoys now refute them.
Malformed counts/types/settings/programs, duplicate inputs, tampered labels, forged certificates, and missing queries are rejected.
Final focused suite: 20 passed. Bounded sweep: 64 seeds, 384 episodes, 2,944 inputs, plus 144 protected-Racket labels.
Authoring preflight, protected causal replay, one-query public projection, public conformance, and private/future mutation invariance passed on bound source.
The base's production lesson floor remains three; the separate parametric family supports two through six demonstrations and exactly four sequential queries.
Finite named-rival/seed evidence is not a universal uniqueness proof. Owner source review, native qualification/acceptance, and training admission remain pending.

sequential_dependency.intermediate: The coordinates and per-column counts of red centers produced by stage A, with the unique maximum selecting the busiest activated column.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Fill each black cell whose immediate vertical neighbors are green with red, producing the canonical stage-A grid.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Recolor every green cell in the selected busiest activated column blue while preserving every stage-A red center and all other cells.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Stage A creates the red centers that B counts. Skipping A leaves all counts at zero on admitted inputs, selects column zero rather than the input-dependent busiest column, and also omits the canonical red fills.
